crime.value: Poisoning via rat poison in milk; central question: will the poisoning be discovered before or after death, and will it appear as suicide or murder?
crime.quote: He opened the package and, with a teaspoon, dropped two helpings of the rat poison into the milk.

victim.value: Elsie Parnell, bedridden wife in wheelchair for 10 years, emotionally abusive and bitter, dependent on husband's care, killable due to isolation and emotional cruelty she inflicts
victim.quote: She sat silently, bitterly...her silence was broken only when she was shrieking at him, complaining about this or that.

culprit_and_motive.value: Rutherford Parnell (husband) murders Elsie to escape 10 years of emotional abuse and imprisonment in the marriage; motive is liberation and psychological relief from unbearable suffering
culprit_and_motive.quote: I hate her too. I wish she'd die, so I could be free...After all, this present cost me over three thousand dollars!

investigator.value: The reader experiences the mystery through Rutherford's first-person perspective as perpetrator; no external investigator introduced in excerpt
investigator.quote: The idea had come to him suddenly, and he had been fascinated by it.
